text.p: Bonds continued easy but shrugged off the U.S. retail sale figures. Traders did not expect the longer end to lose much more during the afternoon.
Interest was likely remain focused on the short to medium part of the curve, they added.

"After the (U.S.) retail sales, bonds corrected, but then they recovered as the market took a clearer look at the figures," said one trader, who added that the data did not seem to point to any particular inflationary pressure.
"The 10 years are down but support is beginning to appear around the 6.35 percent level," said one trader.
Traders said that there was more interest at the short to medium part of the curve where prices had not adjusted fully yet to Friday's 30 basis point rate cut by the Bank of Portugal.
